text: I bought the Aurora X2 recently and it really did hit for me. The sound. It's not just good sound quality but crisp and the bass has depth and its deep and resonates. Also noise cancellation really does work super well to block out noise on the commute, which I really appreciate. The battery is good though, so it'll last near 30 hours before needing a charge. But the cushions for the ears really get uncomfortable if you do a long session, not great. And the app sometimes disconnects. For $149 its pretty good value for money and I would just recommend the Aurora X2 for someone that wants something for everyday use.
